content.text:
ACT CRM says:
The brief mostly matches the ACT files I can read, but it relies on newer files I can't open. I'm a separate ACT agent: hub messaging doesn't include Codex session 01a10f75-…, so I haven't asked it to confirm anything.

All the files I checked are in `~/co-founder/jarvis/brain/hub/agents/builder/act-evidence/`. That copy stops on 18 Oct, so I couldn't check anything the brief cites from after that.

**Confirmed against the files**
- **Client:** ACT Certification, with Scott, Alex, Julie and Jack Rowe as the staff accounts (`release-2026-10-16/RELEASE-STATUS.txt`). The email domain is actcertification.com.au. Nothing I can read uses the full legal name "ACT Certification Services Pty Ltd", so that needs checking.
- **Discovery:** the walkthrough on Friday 9 Oct is backed by `call-2026-10-09/deliverables/client-follow-up-email-ready-to-send.txt` and `testing-plan.txt`. The brief also cites `call-review.html` and `action-register.json`, which aren't in my copy, so I couldn't check them.
- **Workflow and pains:**
  - Jotform intake: four forms covering ACT/NSW proposals and inspections (`handover/BUILD-STATUS-2026-10-18-automation.txt`).
  - Pricing and choosing from 9 Word templates; Appointment of Certifier; signatures, invoice, payment, assessment and inspections (`handover/ACT-status-and-remaining-work-2026-10-17.txt`).
  - Microsoft calendar with day-before reminders and Y/N replies (same file, step 8).
  - Document dropdown and naming were requested. Filename auto-routing was only suggested. AI template suggestions are in scope with staff review; AI setting fees or approving compliance is not (`BUILD-STATUS-2026-10-18-automation.txt`, "Scope clarification" section).
  - Invoicing starts at 100% upfront with 60/40 exceptions (`call-2026-10-09/deliverables/client-follow-up-email-ready-to-send.txt`).
  - All of these match the brief.
- **Built:** proposal editor with GST and saved versions, a library of 14 government PDFs, signing with DocuSign tested only in its test environment, and inspection booking. Live as of the 18 Oct release (`development-2026-10-17/RELEASE-2026-10-18.txt`, `release-2026-10-16/RELEASE-STATUS.txt`). Matches the brief.
- **Not yet accepted:**
  - Jotform intake is built but not switched on.
  - Production DocuSign isn't connected.
  - No real Xero invoice has gone through end to end.
  - Microsoft and Twilio are waiting on ACT.
  - Staff permission levels aren't built.
  - Inspection report saving failed its 9 Oct test, with no fix on file.
  - None of the 23 formal acceptance checks has been run (`handover/ACT-CRM-workflow-acceptance.csv`).
  - My J-188 summary is in `~/co-founder/jarvis/brain/hub/agents/act/tasks/J-188/`.
  - The brief's "Still to prove" list matches these.
- **Fee, support and timing:** there's no evidence of an implementation fee, support price or signed milestones. The only dates on file are Blake's proposed target of 20 Oct for an internal rollout and 16 Oct for client testing (`handover/ACT-CRM-client-email.txt`), and both slipped. The brief is right not to state any terms.

**Where the brief and my files differ**
1. **Newer releases:** the brief cites `release-2026-10-28-live` and `development-2026-10-27/tests/`. Neither is in my copy, so I can't confirm a 28 Oct live release. Builder would need to copy those folders across.
2. **Workflow details my files don't cover:** separate Enquiries, Proposals and Projects; keeping enquiries that don't convert; and the contacts directory (builders, engineers, energy assessors). These probably come from `call-review.html`, which I can't open.
3. **Appointment of Certifier:** the brief describes preparing a three-page form. In my files it's only a downloadable original, with no autofill (`release-2026-10-16/RELEASE-STATUS.txt`). That's probably newer work I can't see.
4. **Legal name:** "ACT Certification Services Pty Ltd" isn't in my copy.
5. **Separate warning:** the 6 Oct audit says the original contract and proposal were never supplied (`handover/ACT-CRM-recovery-and-14-day-plan.html`). Any commercial terms have to come from Blake.

I haven't changed any code, contacted the client or touched any live system.
